source_review: B3 follows B1 and B2 in AssignmentManager.preTransitCheck. Healthy TestRegionMove evaluates B3 twice at unassign/assign, both false; the final move after synchronous disable throws preceding B2 DoNotRetryRegionException, which the JUnit catches through its DoNotRetryIOException superclass. TableStateManager.isTableState catches a meta-read IOException and returns false, but its cached table state produced zero MetaTableAccessor.getTableState I/O points for this table in the healthy run. DisableTableProcedure writes DISABLING, closes regions, then writes DISABLED. Healthy tracing placed those two state writes after both B3 evaluations; six exact faults on them left no later B3 visit. Four exact faults on earlier ENABLING/ENABLED writes retained a later B3 evaluation, but it stayed false and the original JUnit passed. The precise selected B3 DoNotRetryIOException occurred zero times in both the RPC and META phases.

supplemental_meta_state_phase.instrumentation_provenance: case-local HBase12MetaAgent + HBase10Agent; JaCoCo production classes; no GraphChecker runtime, woven classes, skeleton, graph or closure
supplemental_meta_state_phase.coverage_scope_note: Ten production classes including MetaTableAccessor and TableStateManager; never unioned with the preceding RPC-only campaign's nine-class scope
supplemental_meta_state_phase.workload_order_review: Healthy trace: ENABLING/ENABLED meta writes precede B3 at unassign/assign; DISABLING/DISABLED writes follow both B3 evaluations. The final move after synchronous disable throws preceding B2 DoNotRetryRegionException, so B3 is not evaluated. No MetaTableAccessor.getTableState I/O occurred for this table in the healthy run because TableStateManager had cached its state.

completion_review: Original TestRegionMove.testDisableAndMove reached exact B3 after 98 fully matched RPC fault trials (18 shared, 80 unique), with no exact B3 DoNotRetryIOException. A separate ten-class META TableState I/O phase used its own healthy coverage baseline and ten strict single-fault trials: four early ENABLING/ENABLED writes retained B3 after injection, six later DISABLING/DISABLED writes occurred after all B3 evaluations. All ten original JUnit runs passed; no selected B3 exception. No confirmed new bug. The sequential JUnit cannot exercise B3 after disable because final move is preempted by B2; this limits the result.
workload_limitation: The original JUnit has no post-disable B3 evaluation: its final move first fails B2 on the CLOSED region. Healthy TableState reads were served from cache, so no MetaTableAccessor.getTableState point was observed for precise read fault injection.
